dc58a515:  ;
 ;DGJXE14 is an INPUT TRANSFORM for the SIGNED BY field (#10.06) of the
 ;CLINICIAN FILE (#393). It serves the following functions:
 ;
 ;  1. Sets up initial variables for standard VA FileMan conventions.
 ;  2. Retrieves the Signature Information from the "DT" Multiple.
 ;  3. Displays prompts for editing the Transcribed, Signed, and Signed No Review states.
 ;  4. Sets the SIGNED BY VALUE to the .01 field of the NEW PERSON file (#200).
 ;  5. Transfers control to DGJXE15 for additional processing.
47769ba0: ;Go to BEGIN label.
b02d333e: ;Set variables for standard VA FileMan conventions.
3c3656ce: ;If signature exists, get person who signed.
b0c52680: ;Kill scratch variable.
6f6b056a: ;Write caption for prompt.
92fc8e7b: ;Exit point for no field interaction.
73b5827f: ;Write current value, go to next line if value exceeds 45 columns.
4d432f10: ;If field value too long for output window, go to reader help.
d936bc94: ;If input variable defined, and defined for narrative answers, and the field is file identifier type, prohibit editing and use existing value.
66e3792a: ;Read new value, set time out and input error traps.
43c4b5b1: ;Exit point for no changes being made.
59241448: ;Increment record being edited.
11512f2e: ;Branch to procedure based on record being edited.
98232b97: ;If SIGNATURE record exists, reset variables and re-read the values.
5ad8277a: ;If X is null and DV doesn't contain 'R' (Required), set X to null.
05646c02: ;If X starts with '^', branch to ^DIE17 to handle FileMan options.
4295cc14: ;If X is '@', branch to Z^DIE2 to handle jumping.

2c2a2d49: ;If X is a space, DV contains 'd' (Default), and the user has a DEFAULT value defined for this field, set X to that value. If DV doesn't contain 'D' (Disregard Properties) or 'S' (System Computed), write the Default value.

d5c1ebdc: ;If DV allows Multi-valued entries, or DV contains 'V' (Value-only), branch to ^DIE3. Otherwise, if DV doesn't contain 'S' (System Computed), branch to P to handle Pointer/List entries. If a Help Message exists, execute the code from ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1).
0cf4f950: ;Loop through the values in the Multiple for the current entry.
0d967a6c: ;If the current value doesn't match the user's input, write the remaining part of the Multiple and set X to the next ';' piece.
2b3bbd73: ;If DV contains 'P' (Pointer/List), set up DIC and DIC(0) for the Pointer/List lookup, call ^DIC, and set X to the IEN selected. If no entry was selected, branch to X to exit.
cdd90703: ;If DV doesn't contain 'N' (Numeric), branch to V. Otherwise, call D to set up DQ(DQ), check if the number has more than 24 decimal places, and if so, set X to null and branch to Z to exit.
264e499e: ;If the field is Numeric and the input contains a decimal point, remove leading/trailing zeros and check for a trailing decimal point. If so, convert X to an integer.
5034d273: ;Execute the code from the 'X' node for the current DQ value to perform any additional data validation/transformation.
040afe88: ;If X is not null or the UP-ARROW, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set the user's DEFAULT value for this field to X.
3a57a506: ;If X is invalid, write a '??' and branch to Z^DIE17 if the current DQ value has Branching Logic code.
ee4e3bfb: ;Set X to '?BAD' to indicate an invalid value.
7af28d2f: ;If X is a '?', branch to QQ^DIEQ to handle Help processing.
427ed7e9: ;Stores variables for the field being edited.
854ec884: ;If there is no data in DE(DQ), display the input reader prompt and read input.
bfe549a4: ;If there is data in DE(DQ), set Y to the data value and X to the display value.

54092b1b: ;If the data value for the field is a pointer to a file entry,
;retrieve the .01 field value from the pointed-to entry.

3a17b1ef: ;If the data value is a pointer to a MUMPS global,
;retrieve the .01 field value from the pointed-to global.
ed386f3d: ;If the data value is a set of codes, retrieve the appropriate code description.
7b4d68b1: ;If input is null and field is not required, accept null input.
8554765f: ;If the field is an identifier or #-type cross-reference, branch to identifier code.
713dc25e: ;Execute the identifier code.
ef20c35a: ;Return from the field input loop.
d4463b78: ;Set the name of the routine and initialize the field sequence number.
0723d976: ;Initialize variables for field #.06 - SIGNED BY.
98d13581: ;Set the prefix for VA PERSON file entries.
bcb94ea8: ;Go to the input reader code.
4e31ebb6: ;No executable code for this field.

bdc91aab: 1
